jobs.description: Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep. Your main focus will be learning to manage a team as well as developing a summer project in partnership with your site leadership. Site placement is matched by aligning your location preferences with location availability after your interview. Summer relocation and housing assistance provided if eligible. Key job responsibilities • Learn to coach, manage and develop a team of 50-100 Amazon Associates. • Drive standard work and continuous improvement through an intern project. • Work independently and operate in an autonomous environment. • Stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours. • Willing and able to regularly work shift patterns that include nights, weekends, and/or holidays based on business needs. While shifts vary site to site, most follow a fixed 4-day work week with 3 days off. • Oversee truck deliveries, handle and sort packages using pallet jacks, operate PIT equipment (at applicable facilities) and step in as needed. • Work in an environment where the noise level varies. • Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach. • Climb and descend stairs (when applicable). A day in the life As an Area Manager intern, no two days look exactly the same, but every shift gives you the chance to learn how to lead a team, solve real problems, and directly impact how millions of customers receive their orders. Start of Shift: Set the Tone • Shadow a current Area Manager and begin to: • Get a handoff from the outgoing manager and review what's carrying over so nothing falls through the cracks. • Lead a team huddle to kick off the shift. Huddles are used to align on goals, safety priorities, and key focus areas. • Confirm your team is in place, positioned for success, and ready to go before operations begin. Middle of Shift: Lead from the Floor • Walk the floor regularly to stay connected to your team, spot issues early, and keep things running smoothly. • Drive results across safety, quality, and productivity — balancing all three in real time. • Adjust staffing and resources as volume and priorities shift throughout the day. • Coach and develop your team members, respond to challenges as they come up, and partner with support teams to remove roadblocks. • Keep peers and leadership informed on how the shift is tracking and flag risks before they become problems. • Develop your internship project. End of Shift: Close Strong • Do a final walkthrough to make sure your area is clean, organized, and set up for the next team's success. • Review your shift's performance data and capture what went well and what to improve • Hand off to the incoming manager with a clear picture of priorities, open items, and next steps. • Wrap up any remaining administrative tasks so you leave the shift with a clean slate. Every shift, you'll see the direct results of your leadership: from the energy of your team to the packages that reach customers' doorsteps. This is where your decisions have real, visible impact.

Amazon Aurora MySQL 및 Aurora PostgreSQL 클러스터를 프로덕션 환경에서 운영 및 관리합니다.

jobs.description: Amazon operates the world's most complex supply chain — fulfilling global demand for hundreds of millions of products at lighting fast delivery speeds. What is the long-term customer impact of changes in availability and delivery speed? And much more. We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever. Our work spans the full lifecycle: from foundational research and large-scale experimentation to production deployment and downstream impact measurement. We need your skills to help us push the boundaries of what's possible. In this role, you will define and drive the long-term vision for both established and greenfield forecasting products within an ever-evolving supply chain landscape. You will partner closely with scientists and engineers to build state-of-the-art deep learning-based systems that generate the predictions and estimates required to optimize Amazon's supply chain at scale. This role offers a unique opportunity to learn how we bring advanced science — including Deep Learning, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models — out of the lab and into production systems that serve Amazon's worldwide supply chain. jobs.description: Director of Strategy, OFSE Are you passionate about shaping business strategy by turning market intelligence, competitive insights, and financial analysis into actionable growth opportunities across the energy industry? This role will help shape OFSE strategy by translating market, competitive, portfolio, technology, and financial insights into clear business choices and executable actions. The ideal candidate brings strategic thinking, structured problem-solving, strong executive communication, while building practical solutions within a global technology business. As a Director of Strategy, OFSE, you will be responsible for: Taking ownership of delivering the long-range plan for OFSE while developing competitive and strategic insights to translate those into business actions and results. Outside of the team, this role requires close engagement internally with other functions like Technology, Sales & Commercial, Finance and Business Development (M&A). Getting involved in long-term planning, market intelligence and contribute to the overall strategy. Driving the strategy deployment framework: Develop and manage the governance, cadence, ownership model, and execution tracking that translate OFSE strategy into business actions across functions, regions, and product lines. Translating insights into action: Assess market trends, customer opportunities, competitor strategy and performance, technology shifts, and financial implications; convert insights into practical business recommendations and competitive response options. Supporting M&A and portfolio choices: Contribute to M&A gameboards, market assessments of potential acquisitions, partnership choices, portfolio realignment, adjacency opportunities, and make-buy-partner decisions.
